text: Developing a mobile app requires more than just a clever idea. One crucial step is deciding between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for a specific system, like iOS or Android, offering top performance and smooth access to device features. Cross-platform tools save time and money by using one codebase for both, but they may face small performance drawbacks. Regardless of your choice, responsive design is essential. Your app must adapt seamlessly to different screen sizes and orientations. Finally, app stores like Google Play and the App Store are your main distribution channels. They have strict guidelines and review processes, so testing for stability and speed before submission is vital for user satisfaction and approval.
